name: Index Law
long_description:
Index Law is building Mike-1, a superhuman AI lawyer*! Mike is an AI legal agent that gives every business the capabilities of a world-class legal team. 

Unlike traditional legal AI tools that help lawyers work faster, Mike gets legal work done directly for your business. It understands your business, reviews and negotiates contracts, handles corporate matters, and brings in vetted human lawyers when specialist expertise is needed.

Your documents, agreements, signatures, and legal history live in one workspace. Mike remembers your business and becomes more useful with every matter.

We're starting with contracts and corporate work for startups and growing businesses. Early customers have turned around contracts in under an hour and received quotes up to 80% below traditional law firm alternatives.

Our ambition is to make legal services work like software: instantly accessible, deeply personalized, and capable of handling increasingly complex work.

Try Mike: https://usemike.com

*Note: Mike-1 is an AI legal agent, not a licensed or practicing lawyer. Qualified human lawyers provide legal advice and representation where required.
